focusedModelSuite.note: The clean review worktree had no node_modules. The fast-check-dependent tests were therefore executed read-only in the frozen implementation worktree after independently proving its head and tree exactly matched this review target; concurrency and adversarial model probes ran in the isolated review worktree.

phase1Ci.resumptionAction: Coordinator runs the one serialized full Phase 1 CI at the unchanged frozen implementation head after all four review lanes freeze.

findings.evidence: Receiving action-1 with expiresAt=2, advancing time to 1, and receiving the same action ID with expiresAt=8 replaces the pending object's expiry with 8. The received set remains unique and violations() returns no finding, so the current duplicate check proves list uniqueness but not idempotent state.
findings.impact: A duplicate native action can extend the original acceptance window and remain consumable after its authoritative TTL, violating duplicate idempotency and the expired-action acceptance boundary.
findings.requiredResolution: Make an already-pending action ID an immutable no-op or explicit denied duplicate, retain its original expiry, and add a deterministic historical/current fixture plus property assertion for duplicate-before-expiry and duplicate-after-expiry sequences.

findings.evidence: A receive_push command with mustReport=true and no report_callkit command leaves callKitReported empty while violations() returns no finding. The invariant only fires after complete_push, so an unreported must-report push may remain indefinitely MODEL_CLEAR. The command vocabulary also has native_answer but no native Decline, Cancel, Timeout, Busy, or corresponding exact cleanup transitions.
findings.impact: The T2 report can pass while the core PushKit must-report obligation is unsatisfied and while the required decline/cancel/timeout lifecycle has no executable state or invariant coverage.
findings.requiredResolution: Represent an outstanding must-report obligation with an explicit bounded/terminal evaluation point, require report before completion, and add native decline, cancel, timeout/busy, presentation dedupe, and exact cleanup commands with historical/current fixtures. Keep physical delivery separately BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

findings.evidence: A manual event at time 20 stores eventTime=20 and test_only. A provider purchase at time 10 then raises maxAuthoritativeTime to 10 but is discarded because it is older than the non-authoritative eventTime. The final state remains test_only/providerBacked=false, and eventTime 20 is not less than maxAuthoritativeTime 10, so the ordering invariant reports no violation.
findings.impact: Manual, test, or migration evidence can suppress a real provider-backed event. The model therefore does not prove that only newer authoritative provider state can override provider entitlement state.
findings.requiredResolution: Separate provider-authoritative ordering from non-authoritative/test evidence, compare provider events only against the authoritative cursor with defined equal-time ordering, and add mixed-authority duplicate/out-of-order sequences that must preserve provider truth.

findings.evidence: install_build has no sourceCommit identity. compatible() only checks that an update sourceCommit is truthy, so otherwise-identical updates labeled source-a and unbound-source-b are both accepted with no violation.
findings.impact: The model proves native digest/runtime/channel/platform matching but cannot prove the required source-commit/native-digest binding or reject an update that is not bound to the target build lineage.
findings.requiredResolution: Add the build source/native manifest identity and an explicit accepted update lineage or source/native binding, compare it in compatible(), and add a historical variant demonstrating that a merely non-empty source commit is insufficient.

findings.evidence: forward_correction only increments a counter. Starting from REMOTE_ONLY, the command leaves source null, records no successor version/name/body, remains REMOTE_ONLY, and produces no violation.
findings.impact: MODEL_CLEAR cannot demonstrate that a correction is a new forward-only migration rather than an undeclared count, version reuse, or body rewrite.
findings.requiredResolution: Model immutable deployed migration identity and an explicit successor migration with strictly newer unique version, name, and body hash; require reconciliation/merge rules over the resulting set and add same-version and deployed-body-rewrite counterexamples.

findings.evidence: The LIVEKIT_STAGE_SKIPPED condition requires index >= first_media (7) and index < subscription (6), which is impossible. Fixed transitions currently reject non-next stages, but no stage-skip escaped-defect fixture proves the invariant itself and no visited-stage prefix is retained.
findings.impact: The transition guard currently protects the happy model, but the advertised missing-stage invariant has a dead detection branch and can regress without an executable counterexample.
findings.requiredResolution: Track the visited stage prefix or otherwise encode the ordered-chain invariant, fix the predicate, and add a stage-skip historical variant that is detected while the current transition sequence passes.
